name: First Copper Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: First Copper Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing, sales, and processing of various copper products and copper sheets in Taiwan, Mainland China, Japan, and internationally. The company offers oxygen free copper, brass, and phosphor bronze; leadframe copper alloy and copper tin alloy; corson, special copper alloy, and tin brass; and tin plating. It serves its products to electronic and semi-conductive industries. First Copper Technology Co., Ltd. was formerly known as First Copper & Iron Co., Ltd. and changed its name to First Copper Technology Co., Ltd. in January 2000. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
